notify_down_body: easytier-cli can no longer reach the core; the mesh may be down
panel_cli_missing: not found (set an absolute path in the plugin settings)
panel_connectors_toggle: Click to show or hide the connector list
panel_offline: EasyTier core is not running, or the RPC portal is unreachable
panel_offline_hint: Make sure easytier-core is running and its --rpc-portal matches this plugin's setting.
panel_servers_toggle: Click to show or hide server nodes
panel_routes_toggle: Click to show or hide the route table
panel_source: Source: %s (read-only, EasyTier config is never modified)

cli_path.description: Leave empty to use easytier-cli from PATH; set an absolute path to pick another build.
cli_path.label: easytier-cli path

crit_latency_ms.description: Best latency at or above this value is reported as critical (it wins over the warning threshold).
crit_latency_ms.label: Critical latency (ms)

display.description: What the widget shows next to the glyph.
display.label: Bar text

fetch_extras.description: Also read routes, connectors, proxies and port forwarding while the panel is open (a few extra subprocess calls).
fetch_extras.label: Read extra info in panel

glyph.description: Tabler icon shown in the bar.
glyph.label: Glyph

glyph_color.description: "By health" follows the mesh state; the other options pin one theme role.
glyph_color.label: Glyph color

hide_when_stopped.description: Hide the whole widget while the core is not running.
hide_when_stopped.label: Hide when offline

instance_id.description: Passed to easytier-cli -i/--instance-id; prefer this when you know the instance id.
instance_id.label: Instance ID

instance_name.description: Passed to easytier-cli -n/--instance-name; only needed with several instances on one host.
instance_name.label: Instance name

loss_crit_percent.description: Any peer at or above this packet loss is reported as critical.
loss_crit_percent.label: Critical loss (%)

loss_warn_percent.description: Any peer at or above this packet loss is reported as degraded; raise it so an occasional 1% jitter does not keep the widget yellow.
loss_warn_percent.label: Warning loss (%)

max_peers.description: How many peers the panel lists before collapsing the rest behind an expand button.
max_peers.label: Peer list limit

server_prefix.description: Hostnames containing any of these prefixes are treated as shared server nodes: grouped separately and collapsed by default. Separate prefixes with commas.
server_prefix.label: Server node prefixes

notify_state_change.description: Send a notification when the mesh goes from working to unreachable (and back).
notify_state_change.label: Notify on state change

refresh_seconds.description: How often easytier-cli is called again (2-600 seconds).
refresh_seconds.label: Refresh interval (s)

relay_warn.description: Treat peers reached through a relay as degraded (relays add latency).
relay_warn.label: Warn on relayed peers

rpc_portal.description: RPC portal of easytier-core, 127.0.0.1:15888 by default; leave empty for the default.
rpc_portal.label: RPC portal

show_glyph.description: Turn off to keep the text only.
show_glyph.label: Show glyph

warn_latency_ms.description: Best latency at or above this value is reported as degraded.
warn_latency_ms.label: Warning latency (ms)

tt_hint_off: Check that easytier-core is running; left click opens the panel
